import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='pclass', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'], alpha=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([survived_ages, died_ages], bins=20, label=['Survived', 'Did Not Survive'], 
         color=['#2ECC71', '#E74C3C'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation point
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
embark_survival = embark_survival[embark_survival['embarked'].notna()]
embark_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
embark_survival['port'] = embark_survival['embarked'].map(embark_labels)
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival['port'], embark_survival['mean'], 
               color=['#3498DB', '#9B59B6', '#F39C12'], alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 0.6)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
# Add count labels on bars
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, embark_survival['count'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
             f'n={int(count)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Fare distribution by survival and class
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass in [1, 2, 3]:
    survived_fare = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 1)]['fare']
    died_fare = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 0)]['fare']
    
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='pclass', y='fare', hue='survived', split=True, 
               ax=ax4, palette={0: '#E74C3C', 1: '#2ECC71'}, alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)
ax4.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
